text:
sam: quick heads-up — PR #15587 (feat/kv-prefetch) is blocked by intermittent Buildkite timeouts on integration-stage-3. Merge window today at 4pm PT. Can someone approve a targeted rerun or advise?

maria: saw it. retried once manually but another job timed out. logs excerpt below.

buildkite-bot: Build 12345 failed — job 'integration-stage-3' exited 1 (timeout). https://buildkite.com/redwood/builds/12345

jon: we can do a targeted rebuild of the failing job. if it flakes repeatedly we should consider a 3x rerun policy or a short-term skip for slow tests.

sasha: failing test looks like `tests/test_streaming_kv.py::test_prefetch_timeout` — flaky on CUDA CI nodes.

maria: log snippet:
```
E   TimeoutError: test_integration_timeout after 480s
  file tests/test_streaming_kv.py, line 87
```

maria: tagging code owners — need an approval from @jon or @sam to trigger rebuilds that will affect merge timing.

sam: I can approve. jon, approving now. will kick off a targeted rerun for that job.

jon: approved. recommend rebuild the single job, then run 2 more targeted retries if it still flakes. also consider enabling SKIP_SLOW=true for the PR run to avoid unrelated slow tests.

sam: kicked off targeted rebuild (job id 6790): https://buildkite.com/redwood/builds/12346 — posting results here.

buildkite-bot: Rebuild 12346 started for job integration-stage-3.

maria: if it fails again, capture a full stack trace and the node metadata (instance type, CUDA version). could be infra noise.

sasha: note: if this turns out to be snapshot noise we should NOT update snapshots without a deterministic repro. prefer rerun x3 and debug.

buildkite-bot: Rebuild 12346 failed — timeout again. job 6790. Logs: `RuntimeError: KV fetch timed out after 5000ms`

jon: can someone run `pytest -k test_prefetch_timeout -vv --maxfail=1` on dev-gpu2 to try a local repro? I can free a slot in ~30m.

sam: pinging infra — can we reserve dev-gpu2? @ops-bot please allocate for 30m.

ops-bot: Reserved dev-gpu2 for sam for 30m (expires in 30 minutes).

maria: i've added extra debug logging to the PR branch and a short-run job that only exercises the failing test. link in PR.

sasha: sounds good. hold merge until either 2x successful reruns or a clear root cause + fix. @sam please document rerun history in the PR description.

sam: done — added rerun history and attached the failing logs. waiting for either 2 greens or a fix. thanks all :thumbsup:
